target.body:
## Summary
- add `send-rich --url <url> --rich-link` for bridge-backed URL preview balloon sends
- forward RPC `send.rich` params `url` + `rich_link: true` into the bridge
- build URL preview payloads as `RichLink`-rooted archives containing fetched `LPLinkMetadata`, matching Messages.app compose-generated URLBalloonProvider payload shape
- link the injected helper against LinkPresentation in all helper build/sign paths
- fix queued CLI/RPC identity resolution so URL-only rich-link sends resolve using the effective URL text
- remove the release-owned changelog edit; release-note context stays in this PR body

## Redacted runtime proof on lobster
Proof collected on lobster with branch-local artifacts from `feat/rich-links` and a freshly relaunched SIP-disabled injected Messages.app session. Raw logs stay local because they include chat GUIDs, message GUIDs, row IDs, and local identifiers.

- branch head after payload-fidelity fix: `c751c63`
- latest runtime proof directory: `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-08/165-rich-links/lobster-url-20260708-221800`
- visual captures: `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-08/165-rich-links/lobster-url-20260708-221800/visual/messages-after-lobster-url.png`, `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-08/165-rich-links/lobster-url-20260708-221800/visual/messages-after-lobster-url-bottom.png`
- test chat: `Lobster Test Group` (chat row 22; GUID redacted in PR text)
- before-fix bridge rows: row 6725 had no `balloon_bundle_id` and no `payload_data`; recipient-side UI showed load-preview placeholders
- intermediate fix proof: row 6737 persisted `balloon_bundle_id=com.apple.messages.URLBalloonProvider`, `payload_data` length 604, and a `RichLink` archive root
- metadata-fetch proof: row 6743 for `https://imsg.sh` persisted `payload_data` length 1775 and the archive included `RichLink`, `LPLinkMetadata`, title `Messages.app from your terminal`, summary, siteName, and icon/image metadata
- richer URL proof: row 6745 for `https://lobster.shahine.com/` persisted `payload_data` length 242100 and the archive included `RichLink`, title/summary/siteName, `summary_large_image`, and multiple image/icon URLs
- sender-side visual proof now shows the bridge-generated `imsg.sh` URL preview rendering as a full title card instead of the earlier placeholder/empty payload behavior
